newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Three civilians dead as S.Korea hunts intruders.
newsitem.headline: Three civilians dead as S.Korea hunts intruders.

text.p: Three South Korean civilians have been found dead in an area where troops are hunting North Korean infiltrators, a defence ministry official said on Wednesday.
The official in the east coast city of Kangnung said he could give no details on the deaths.
State radio reported that two of the three had been shot in the head while the other had been battered to death with a heavy implement.
Earlier on Wednesday the Kangnung official said two local residents had gone missing while picking mushrooms in mountains near the city.

Last month a North Korean submarine landed 26 agents on a beach near Kangnung. Of these, 22 have been killed by Southern troops or found dead, one has been captured alive and a hunt is under way for the other three.
